_comment: Crates a core plugin (plugins/core/*) may depend on. Checked by tools/check_plugin_crates.py. versions: locked versions that are allowed. wasm_safe: false keeps the crate out of plugin dependencies. default_features: required value of the dependency's default-features switch (omit for no requirement). required_features and forbidden_features constrain the enabled feature list. A crate missing from Cargo.lock is added only by the imports stream on a porter's request, after a wasm32 build passes.

ilium-plugin-sdk.note: Workspace crate; the only way a plugin reaches the host.

chrono.note: Calendar arithmetic only; the clock comes from the `clock` import, never from the system.

handlebars.note: Prompt templates of the compaction plugin; pure Rust, already in use.

image.note: Decode and encode through an explicit codec list; allowed after a wasm32 Clippy job proves it.

png.note: PNG codec; allowed after a wasm32 Clippy job proves it.

syntect.note: Needs default-features = false plus default-fancy; not locked yet.

ureq.note: Host side only (the http import); a plugin uses the `http` import.

reqwest.note: Host side only; a plugin uses the `http` import.
